create_qwen2moe_config: create a Qwen2MoeConfig instance with custom model parameters for a MoE transformer
initialize_qwen2moe_model: initialize a Qwen2MoeModel from a Qwen2MoeConfig for inference or training
configure_moe_experts: configure MoE layer parameters including num_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and router_aux_loss_coef
set_layer_types: set layer_types to alternate between sliding_attention and full_attention per layer
setup_tensor_parallel_plan: setup base_model_tp_plan and base_model_pp_plan for tensor and pipeline parallelism
